title: Rural HF Pocket Guide — HEARTLAND Protocol v3.3 (PWA)
description: Offline-capable, zero-login Progressive Web App exposing the essential clinical reference content of the HEARTLAND Protocol v3.3 for primary care clinicians managing heart failure in rural and resource-limited US settings. Reference-only. No patient data input.
notes: Content mirrors HEARTLAND Protocol v3.3 (Cureus, 2025). Code: MIT license. Clinical content: non-commercial educational and clinical reference use with attribution.
